# Code of Conduct

Truck TMS is a small, friendly open-source project. Everyone is welcome, whatever their experience,
background, language or where they come from. *Türkçe ya da İngilizce yazabilirsiniz.*

## Our standards

Please:

- be kind and patient, especially with newcomers and people writing in their second language;
- give and take feedback about code and ideas, not about people;
- assume good intent and ask before concluding.

Not acceptable: harassment, insults, discriminatory jokes or language, personal attacks,
publishing someone's private information, or any other behavior that would make people feel unsafe.

## Scope

This applies in the repository (issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews) and anywhere you
represent the project.

## Reporting

If someone's behavior bothers you, contact the maintainer at **arslaneren.dev@gmail.com**.
Reports are handled privately. The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close threads or block
accounts that break this code of conduct.

This code of conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1.
